reviews.title: The best of this type of book, brilliant and brain taxing.
reviews.body: What can I say, this book totally grabbed my attention. It’s fun, easy to follow, mind boggling at times. Enjoyed the different categories with their own clues. Took me a couple of weeks to do doing a category every day or so. Cannot wait for book 2!I’ve bought a lot of these type of books and have either got bored or given the book to a friend to compete. Not this one it’s been sat if my table waiting for when I needed a puzzle fix. Thank you for writing this book please please make more
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 13 July 2026

reviews.title: Fantastic from start to finish
reviews.body: Fantastic from start to finish. Love the story telling throughout, made me feel like I was doing a real investigation. The suspects file way of excluding things is really neat.Worth going online when you've worked it out as there's a full story of what you were investigating and why the investigator and original killing was doneCan't wait to do the next two.

reviews.title: Oddly satisfying!
reviews.body: This book is big! It took me several sittings to finish. It's an absolute waste of time but oddly satisfying! I recommend using a pencil or cheap pens, you will go through a lot of ink crossing out.It's easy to complete. Each section you read the clues and cross out any names/items/places that don't apply to that clue. By the last clue you should have an answer to that section.You can then eliminate suspects listed in the back of the book if they don't match that answer for that section. You repeat until only one suspect is left. You can then check if you are correct.

reviews.title: Nothing so far beats Alice’s book, esp when errors are involved…
reviews.body: I am only half way through the book but have already possibly found an error. Although it might be easy to assume it’s the other thing, there really shouldn’t be an error in a book that’s quite pricey. I have tried emailing the author, not sure who else other than bring it up with Amazon to contact. Maybe there’s another edition and I happened to get the edition which has the error in it. If so, then maybe a refund is due? Can’t return it as it’s been highlighted on. Things like this you’d hope would be proof-read more than once to realise an error as it’s part of the clue that’s needed for the end. Only giving one star for this reason. I also need to point out that the book is very repetitive and not much Imagination for names/places etc were used. Gets boring the same things over and over. For example - known address section - a lot of the names for addresses were repeated constantly and because of this you can easily do it with your eyes closed. Was hoping it would be a more challenging book like Alice’s as that one was so much fun to do. So if you haven’t done Alice’s book definitely give it a go.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 14 July 2026

reviews.title: ⭐️ Bought For Holiday, Can’t Put It Down! ⭐️
reviews.body: I don’t usually review products I’ve bought, but I had to review this one. I’m so pleased Amazon recommended it to me.I originally bought it to take on holiday, but I can’t put it down! The clues are well thought out, and the layout, with the leads arranged in columns, is easy to follow. I haven’t solved it yet, but unlike some similar books, I haven’t got bored, so I don’t think it’ll be long before I do.The only problem I have is... what am I going to take on holiday now?
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 29 June 2026

reviews.title: So much better than other ' The killer isn't' books...
reviews.body: Woah! First up this book is huge! It's over 400 pages with hours of puzzle fun inside.If you like the 'killer isn't' type of books, you're going to absolutely love this. To my mind the author has taken the idea and massively improved it by adding a feeling of actual deduction at the end - having actual uspects you need to collect clues for and review is so much fun! If you know someone who like mystery puzzle that don't break your brain but really make you feel like you're solving something, this book is a must have!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 25 June 2026

reviews.title: So well done. I’m hooked!
reviews.body: I haven’t finished it yet, but I am having such a good time with this book! I’m slowly narrowing down the suspect pool and I keep getting excited every time I complete another batch of clues.This is really well thought out. The clues, categories, suspect details, and whole setup are so clever, and I love that it actually makes you feel like you’re working a case. I also have to say the formatting makes my OCD very happy. 😂Everything is clean, organized, and easy to follow, without feeling cluttered or chaotic.I’m still working my way through it, but I’m already impressed. Such a fun and creative puzzle book. Five stars all the way, and I sure hope there’s an Eliminate 2 coming soon!

reviews.title: Beste puzzelboek dat ik al gekocht heb.
reviews.body: Kei leuk boek!Ik had al de murdle en murdoku boeken, maar dit puzzelboek is veel ontspannender. Hier moet je zo niet bij nadenken,.gewoonweg superleuk om te doen. Ben al in de helft, en als het uit is ga ik zeker de 2 de versie ook kopen. Dit is mijn absoluut nummer 1 boek!

reviews.title: Great fun for a different spin on mystery puzzles
reviews.body: Loving the elimination book. I’m just into the mystery books and have tried several styles. It’s nice to switch out especially when some of the others get hard. This is a great book if you like detail. You gets pages of items and a list of 10 hints to eliminate the items or places things etc. so it’s detailed elimination and truly a good way to wind down at the end of the night instead of scrolling on your phone. The one thing I will say it’s a heavy book and for the test that you do it’s way more comfortable to do if you sit at a table or a desk. Most people like to relax with their books so I bought a lap table that tilts and used it for the first time last night and it was great. It was way easier than holding a book you know laying on the couch trying to relax, and then having to hold this thick book and cross out a bunch of stuff. Otherwise it’s fine and I’m happy. I gave it a try.

reviews.title: Great book and lots of fun
reviews.body: Awesome book fun filled great for families to play at a bbq or general games night with trying to solve the mysteries behind it all. Reminds me of cluedo in a way can’t wait to see if more will follow this one

reviews.body: I LOVE this book. It's the best of both worlds: eliminating things but in smaller categories so it's not overwhelming. I just got volume 2 in as well! Can't wait for a volume 3.
